verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's evidence pack is entirely about individual (KYC) identity verification — ID document checks, selfie matching, SSN/ID number validation — with no mention of business registry lookups, UBO (ultimate beneficial owner) identification, or a documented KYB workflow chaining into KYC on owners. This is a real capability gap for an ops lead needing business verification, not a wrong-axis question, since Stripe itself offers separate KYB tooling elsewhere; but no evidence of it appears here.
